items.headline: Qatalyst Notches Its Biggest Deal With Rare Buyside M&A Role
items.excerpt: Qatalyst Partners, the boutique investment bank serving the tech industry, has just landed its biggest-ever deal after diverting from its normal focus on selling companies.

items.headline: Why GTA VI Makes the Case for AI in Gaming
items.excerpt: As development costs soar, studios face growing financial risks and fewer opportunities to experiment. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Gearoid Reidy says AI could make game development cheaper and help revive creativity across the industry. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Apple’s $1 Trillion Rally Leaves No Room for Error on Earnings
items.excerpt: The runup in Apple Inc. shares in recent months has left the iPhone maker little room for disappointment when it reports earnings after the bell on Monday.

items.headline: Supermarkets Across Europe Report Suspected Freezer Hack
items.excerpt: Supermarkets across Europe were hit by suspected cyberattacks that caused sudden changes in the temperatures of their fridges and freezers, weeks after a similar issue in France. Charlotte Hughes-Morgan explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Meta Eyes at Least $20 Billion From Potential Bond Offerings
items.excerpt: Meta Platforms Inc. is eyeing at least $20 billion from a potential cross-border investment-grade bond offering as the tech giant gauges investor interest in its debt amid growing skepticism about the pace of spending on artificial intelligence.

items.headline: DeepSeek Boosts AI Agent Offering With New Creator Mode
items.excerpt: DeepSeek has unveiled a new option to quickly create custom plugins that help users to tackle a range of complex tasks, the latest move by the Chinese lab to bolster its AI agent offerings.

items.headline: Supermarkets in Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Finland Hit by Suspected Freezer Hack
items.excerpt: Supermarkets across Europe were hit by suspected cyberattacks that resulted in sudden changes in the temperatures of their fridges and freezers on Monday, echoing a more widespread problem in France last month.

items.headline: Marvell to Acquire Lumentum in Historic $115 Billion Tech Deal
items.excerpt: Marvell Technology Inc. agreed to buy Lumentum Holdings Inc. at an enterprise value of $115 billion, clinching one of the largest technology deals in history in a push to capitalize on runaway data center spending.

items.headline: NYC Comptroller Steps Up Criticism of Anthropic After IPO Filing
items.excerpt: Anthropic PBC’s approach to its planned initial public offering threatens to disempower shareholders and prevent ordinary people from reining in a potentially dangerous form of technology, according to New York City’s comptroller.

items.headline: Binance Boosts Market Maker Incentives in Wake of Record Hack
items.excerpt: Binance has increased the incentives it offers some market makers to trade on its platform, as the world’s largest crypto exchange seeks to bolster activity on its venue after suffering a record $6.3 billion hack.

items.headline: Anthropic Commits to $895 Billion in Spending as Mega-IPO Nears
items.excerpt: Anthropic PBC disclosed a twelve-fold increase in quarterly revenue while revealing that it intends to spend more than $895 billion in the years ahead, as the artificial intelligence lab courts investors for a potentially-record-breaking IPO.

items.headline: Binance Outflows Reach $4.7 Billion After North Korea Hack
items.excerpt: Binance has experienced $4.7 billion in net outflows since the crypto-exchange giant reinstated withdrawals following a historic hack, a figure that’s grown but is still a small portion of overall assets on the platform.

items.headline: Anthropic Revenue Hits Nearly $17 Billion Before Mega-IPO
items.excerpt: Anthropic PBC reported third-quarter revenue of nearly $17 billion as of Sept. 30, a twelve-fold increase versus the same period a year ago that’s set to stoke anticipation for the artificial intelligence lab’s potentially record-breaking IPO.
